newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH PX50 FALLS SHARPLY AT FIXING.
newsitem.headline: CZECH PX50 FALLS SHARPLY AT FIXING.

text.p: Sharp falls from Czech Major issues pulled the PX50 index down by more than one percent at Monday's price fixing as uncertainty about the Czech crown continued to hurt sentiment in the equities market.

SPT Telecom fell 40 crowns, 1.2 percent, to 3,190, power utility CEZ lost 28 crowns, 2.9 perecent, to 920, Komercni Banka fell 28 crowns, 1.4 percent, to 1,190 and Ceska Sporitelna fell one crown, 0.3 percent, to 290.

After raising the last resort Lombard rate on Friday afternoon to 50 percent from 14 percent to defend the crown against speculators, the central bank hiked the repo rate to 45 percent on overnight operations from 12.9 percent.
The crown steadied on the news, and is currently trading at -2.73 percent from the mid-point of its mark/dollar fixing basket.
